segments.text: So many distributions! Which one should you use?
segments.caption: So many distributions! Which one should you use?

segments.text: Here's a simple cheat sheet.
segments.caption: Here's a simple cheat sheet.

segments.text: First, a quick reminder, in simple words.
segments.caption: First, a quick reminder, in simple words.

segments.text: A probability distribution shows how likely each possible value is.
segments.caption: A probability distribution shows how likely each possible value is.

segments.text: Different questions need different distributions.
segments.caption: Different questions need different distributions.

segments.text: So just ask: what am I measuring?
segments.caption: So just ask: what am I measuring?

segments.text: Are all outcomes equally likely, like a fair dice?
segments.caption: Are all outcomes equally likely, like a fair dice?

segments.text: Use the uniform distribution. Its shape is flat.
segments.caption: Use the uniform distribution. Its shape is flat.

segments.text: Counting successes in a fixed number of tries, like heads in ten coin flips?
segments.caption: Counting successes in a fixed number of tries, like heads in 10 coin flips?

segments.text: That's binomial.
segments.caption: That's binomial.

segments.text: Counting events in a stretch of time, like customers per hour?
segments.caption: Counting events in a stretch of time, like customers per hour?

segments.text: That's Poisson.
segments.caption: That's Poisson.

segments.text: Measuring the waiting time until the next event?
segments.caption: Measuring the waiting time until the next event?

segments.text: That's exponential. Short waits are the most common.
segments.caption: That's exponential. Short waits are the most common.

segments.text: A measurement that clusters around an average, like people's heights?
segments.caption: A measurement that clusters around an average, like people's heights?

segments.text: That's normal, the famous bell curve.
segments.caption: That's normal, the famous bell curve.

segments.text: And if you see two humps?
segments.caption: And if you see two humps?

segments.text: That's bimodal. Usually two groups are mixed together, like a café's lunch rush and dinner rush.
segments.caption: That's bimodal. Usually two groups are mixed together, like a café's lunch rush and dinner rush.

segments.text: So remember: equally likely, uniform. Successes in tries, binomial.
segments.caption: So remember: equally likely, uniform. Successes in tries, binomial.

segments.text: Events in time, Poisson. Waiting time, exponential. Measurements around an average, normal.
segments.caption: Events in time, Poisson. Waiting time, exponential. Measurements around an average, normal.
